_about: Tenant variants: overrides deep-merged over tenant.json, for what production ships OFF by default.
The prototype takes one with ?tenant=<name>; the parity oracle serves the same merged tenant, so both
screens are compared under the same configuration.
all-features   the Raw Material Calculator (appProp.productRawMaterialMapping: which raw materials,
in base units, a batch of each finished product takes) and the create
drawer's barcode scanner flag, spelled as the tenant configs spell it
qrCodeScannerEnabled, never sees: its scan button does not render (README, defects)
no-forecast    the purchase forecast banner switched off
three-part-units  one unitMap entry with a three-part label (Jar/Box/Pallet): the default tenant's
labels are all two-part, and Add New Item's unit picker lists only three-part ones
raw-calc-unmapped  the Raw Material Calculator switched on with no mapping entries yet: its report says so
